dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Approximately five prominent closed-loop 'O' structures are visible in the mid-dorsal region, characterized by high-intensity pixel perimeters with jagged, irregular boundaries and a sharp gradient transition to low-intensity interior centers.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High spatial density of small, solid high-intensity pixel clusters in the anterior dorsal (neck) area and scattered along the lower lateral line, appearing as localized patches without internal gradients.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three largest mid-dorsal ring structures form a distinct scalene triangle, while the relationship between the central annulus and the two nearest high-intensity blobs on the lower flank forms a wide-angle obtuse triangle.

other_distinctive_markers: Continuous mosaic-like interconnection of high-contrast annuli creates a complex 'puzzle-piece' lattice across approximately 60% of the visible flank.
